title_en: Bioinspired gallol-modified chitosan coating for improved tissue adhesion and in vivo catheter fixation.
title_ja: 生体からインスピレーションを得たガロール修飾キトサンコーティングにより、組織接着と生体内カテーテルの固定が向上します。
authors: Hyun Da Han, Hong Yo Bin, Shin Hyun Ho, Jin Eun-Jung, Park Jun Seok, Ryu Ji Hyun
purpose: カテーテルの変位と不適切な固定は、埋め込み型医療機器において依然として大きな課題であり、多くの場合、機器の移動、介入の繰り返し、および治療効果の低下につながります。縫合、機械的固定、接着包帯などのさまざまな固定方法が開発されていますが、湿った生理学的条件下で適切な固定耐久性を維持することは依然として課題です。
methods: 縫合、機械的固定、接着包帯などのさまざまな固定方法が開発されていますが、湿った生理学的条件下で適切な固定耐久性を維持することは依然として課題です。この研究では、カテーテル固定用にカテーテル表面にガロール修飾キトサン (CHI-G) を使用した生体由来の接着コーティングを開発します。組織学的分析、血液学的および生化学的評価、またはウサギの皮膚刺激性試験において、CHI-G コーティングされたカテーテルの全身毒性は検出されませんでした。
results: カテーテルの変位と不適切な固定は、埋め込み型医療機器において依然として大きな課題であり、多くの場合、機器の移動、介入の繰り返し、および治療効果の低下につながります。 CHI-G コーティングされたカテーテル表面は、水接触角の減少とともに親水性の向上を示しました (コーティングされていない対照では 84.9±2.8°、CHI-G_L では 74.4±5.2°、CHI-G_H では 66.3±1.9°)。動物実験では、カテーテル表面のCHI-Gコーティングにより固定耐久性が大幅に向上しました。
conclusion: 組織学的分析、血液学的および生化学的評価、またはウサギの皮膚刺激性試験において、CHI-G コーティングされたカテーテルの全身毒性は検出されませんでした。したがって、CHI-G 接着コーティングは、移植可能な材料とカテーテルを固定するための効果的な生体影響を受けた表面改質アプローチとなります。

abstract_en: Catheter displacement and inadequate fixation remain significant challenges in implantable medical devices, often leading to device migration, repeated interventions, and reduced therapeutic effectiveness. Although various securement methods, such as suturing, mechanical anchoring, and adhesive dressings, have been developed, maintaining adequate fixation durability under wet physiological conditions remains a challenge. This study develops a bioinspired adhesive coating using gallol-modified chitosan (CHI-G) on catheter surfaces for catheter fixation. Two types of CHI-G-coated catheters with low (3-5 μm, CHI-G_L) and high (7-9 μm, CHI-G_H) coating thicknesses were prepared by repeated dehydration cycles of CHI-G. CHI-G-coated catheter surfaces demonstrated enhanced hydrophilicity with a decrease in water contact angles (84.9 ± 2.8 ° for the uncoated control, 74.4 ± 5.2 ° for CHI-G_L, and 66.3 ± 1.9 ° for CHI-G_H). In addition, CHI-G-coated catheter surfaces exhibited excellent adhesion forces (33.1 ± 9.3 kPa for CHI-G_H and 10.6 ± 5.7 kPa for CHI-G_L, respectively) compared to that of unmodified surfaces (2.2 ± 0.8 kPa). In animal experiments, the CHI-G coating on catheter surfaces significantly improved fixation durability. No systemic toxicity of the CHI-G-coated catheter was detected in histological analysis, hematological and biochemical assessments, or rabbit skin irritation tests. Thus, the CHI-G adhesive coating represents an effective bioinspired surface-modification approach for the fixation of implantable materials and catheters.

title_en: Safety of pulsed-field ablation combined with IVUS-guided pulmonary vein stenting during atrial fibrillation ablation: a case report.
title_ja: 心房細動アブレーション中の IVUS 誘導肺静脈ステント留置術と組み合わせたパルスフィールドアブレーションの安全性: 症例報告。
authors: Jadczyk Tomasz, Caratti di Lanzacco Lorenzo, Jarman Julian, Hill Jonathan, Markides Vias
purpose:
肺静脈狭窄 (PVS) は、まれではありますが、心房細動 (AF) アブレーションの重篤な合併症です。ステント移植を伴う血管形成術は、重度の PVS の標準治療です。しかし、再狭窄と再閉塞は依然として頻繁に発生する課題です。肺静脈隔離のための新しい非熱的アブレーション法であるパルスフィールドアブレーション（PFA）は、構造的損傷が最小限に抑えられるため、以前に狭窄した肺静脈を伴う複雑なやり直し処置に特に適しており、より安全である可能性があります。
症例の概要: 50歳の男性は、2023年2月に高周波を使用した肺静脈隔離術を受けました。数か月後、彼は息切れを発症し、コンピューター断層撮影スキャンにより、左下肺静脈(LIPV)と正常な冠状動脈の狭窄が示されました。不整脈も再発していました。 2024 年 3 月、脳保護装置を in situ で装着し、LIPV のきつい狭窄を事前拡張した後、8 × 19 mm Omnilink Elite (Abbott) ステントが展開され、良好な血管造影結果が得られました。 LIPV を除くすべての肺静脈の再接続が高周波エネルギーで行われましたが、狭窄によるさらなる問題を引き起こすことを恐れて LIPV は治療されませんでした。彼は 2024 年 12 月に検査を受け、息切れはなくなりましたが、動悸が再発しました。 2025年の春までに彼は息切れもするようになり、最初のステント留置後エドキサバンとクロピドグレルの投与を続けたにもかかわらず、画像検査で左下葉の灌流が低下したLIPVステントの亜全閉塞が示された。 2025 年 5 月、彼は事前拡張後に 7 mm 薬剤溶出バルーンを使用した血管内超音波 (IVUS) ガイド下バルーン血管形成術を受けるために入院し、ステントの開存性を回復することに成功しました。次に、カテーテルがステントに直接接触するのを避けて、以前にステントを留置した LIPV の周囲を含むすべての肺静脈に対して PFA を実行しました。処置と回復は順調で、患者の症状は著しく改善した。 2026 年 4 月時点では不整脈は発生していませんでした (約 1 年間の追跡調査)。
考察: この症例は、AF アブレーション関連の PVS 管理の複雑さを浮き彫りにし、血行再建の指導における IVUS の役割を強調しています。また、ステント留置された肺静脈付近での PFA (特に Varipulse™、J&J MedTech) の安全性も実証し、追加の構造的損傷を最小限に抑えながら効果的な電気的絶縁を実現します。

abstract_en:
BACKGROUND: Pulmonary vein stenosis (PVS) is an uncommon but serious complication of atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation. Angioplasty with stent implantation is the standard treatment for severe PVS; however, restenosis and re-occlusion remain frequent challenges. Pulsed-field ablation (PFA), a novel non-thermal ablation modality for pulmonary vein isolation, causes minimal structural damage and may therefore be particularly suitable and safer for complex redo procedures involving previously stenosed pulmonary veins.
CASE SUMMARY: A 50-year-old man underwent pulmonary vein isolation using radiofrequency in February 2023. A few months later, he developed breathlessness, and a computed tomography scan showed a stenosis of the left inferior pulmonary vein (LIPV) and normal coronary arteries. He also had recurrent arrhythmias. In March 2024, with a cerebral protection device in situ and following pre-dilatation of a tight stenosis of the LIPV, an 8 × 19 mm Omnilink Elite (Abbott) stent was deployed with a good angiographic result. Reconnections of all pulmonary veins except the LIPV were targeted with radiofrequency energy but the LIPV was not treated for fear of causing further problems with stenosis.He was reviewed in December 2024 and was free from breathlessness but had recurrent palpitations. By spring 2025, he had also become breathless, and imaging showed subtotal occlusion of the LIPV stent with reduced perfusion of the left lower lobe despite continuation of edoxaban and clopidogrel after initial stenting. In May 2025, he was admitted for intravascular ultrasound (IVUS)-guided balloon angioplasty with a 7-mm drug-eluting balloon following pre-dilatation, which successfully restored stent patency. PFA was then performed on all pulmonary veins, including around the previously stented LIPV, avoiding direct catheter contact with the stent. The procedure and recovery were uneventful, and the patient's symptoms improved markedly. He remained free from arrhythmias in April 2026 (∼1 year follow-up).
DISCUSSION: This case highlights the complexity of managing AF ablation-related PVS and underscores the role of IVUS in guiding revascularization. It also demonstrates the safety of PFA (in particular Varipulse™, J&J MedTech) near a stented pulmonary vein, achieving effective electrical isolation with minimal additional structural injury.

title_en: The TOMAX Procedure for Penile Sensory Reconstruction in a Patient with Spina Bifida.
title_ja: 二分脊椎患者における陰茎感覚再建のための TOMAX 手術。

abstract_en: We report the first case of penile sensory reconstruction in a patient with spina bifida in Japan. A 27-year-old man presented with congenital sensory loss in the perineal region owing to spina bifida. His myelomeningocele was repaired immediately after birth. He was unable to recognize bladder fullness and required urinary self-catheterization. Emotional erection and ejaculation were possible, and his gait was normal. We elected to perform the TOMAX procedure (i.e., TO MAXimize sensation, sexuality, and quality of life) to reconstruct penile sensation. Microsurgical sensory nerve anastomosis between the ilioinguinal nerve and the dorsal nerve of the penis was performed bilaterally under general anesthesia. No complications occurred. Penile sensation was noted 3 months after surgery. At the 1-year follow-up, the patient could detect the blue filament on Semmes-Weinstein testing. The TOMAX procedure can provide sensory recovery in patients with spina bifida and improve their quality of life.

title_en: Gram-negative bloodstream infections in pediatric patients: antimicrobial resistance and factors associated with mortality.
title_ja: 小児患者におけるグラム陰性血流感染症：抗菌薬耐性と死亡率に関連する要因。
purpose: グラム陰性血流感染症 (BSI) は、小児患者、特に重症の小児における重大な罹患率と死亡率に関連しています。グラム陰性病原体の抗菌薬耐性の増加により、経験的な治療戦略はさらに複雑になり、治療の選択肢は限られています。この研究は、グラム陰性 BSI の小児患者における抗菌薬耐性パターンと死亡率に関連する要因を評価することを目的としました。
methods: この後ろ向きコホート研究には、2022年1月から2025年9月までに三次医療センターで診断された、検査室でグラム陰性BSIと診断された0～18歳の小児患者が含まれた。人口統計学的特徴、侵襲的処置、検査所見、抗菌薬感受性プロファイル、治療関連の変数、および臨床転帰が分析されました。全死因院内死亡に関連する要因は、探索的多変数ロジスティック回帰モデルを使用して評価されました。
results: 合計252人の小児患者が対象となった。クレブシエラ属(46.4%) およびアシネトバクター属 spp. (28.6%) が最も頻繁に分離された病原体でした。ゲンタマイシン (58.3%)、シプロフロキサシン (57.1%)、イミペネム (56.0%)、およびメロペネム (48.4%) で高い耐性率が観察されました。セフタジジム-アビバクタム耐性は研究年と有意に関連していた(p = 0.008)。全体的な全原因の院内死亡率は 31.7% でした。以前のメロペネム曝露と血液培養採取後の抗菌治療の変更は、死亡率の上昇と関連していた。改訂された多変数モデルでは、中心静脈カテーテルの使用 (調整済み OR=13.58、95% CI: 5.02-36.60)、血小板減少症 (調整済み OR=4.82、95% CI: 2.10-11.02)、完全非経口栄養 (調整済み OR=4.83、95% CI: 2.09-11.13）、機械換気（調整後 OR=3.74、95% CI: 1.41-9.97）、およびメロペネム耐性（調整後 OR=3.00、95% CI: 1.28-7.03）は、独立して死亡率と関連した。

abstract_en:
BACKGROUND: Gram-negative bloodstream infections (BSIs) are associated with substantial morbidity and mortality in pediatric patients, particularly among critically ill children. Increasing antimicrobial resistance among Gram-negative pathogens has further complicated empirical treatment strategies and limited therapeutic options. This study aimed to evaluate antimicrobial resistance patterns and factors associated with mortality in pediatric patients with Gram-negative BSIs.
METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included pediatric patients aged 0-18 years with laboratory-confirmed Gram-negative BSIs diagnosed between January 2022 and September 2025 at a tertiary care center. Demographic characteristics, invasive procedures, laboratory findings, antimicrobial susceptibility profiles, treatment-related variables, and clinical outcomes were analyzed. Factors associated with all-cause in-hospital mortality were evaluated using an exploratory multivariable logistic regression model.
RESULTS: A total of 252 pediatric patients were included. Klebsiella spp. (46.4%) and Acinetobacter spp. (28.6%) were the most frequently isolated pathogens. High resistance rates were observed for gentamicin (58.3%), ciprofloxacin (57.1%), imipenem (56.0%), and meropenem (48.4%). Ceftazidime-avibactam resistance was significantly associated with study year (p = 0.008). The overall all-cause in-hospital mortality rate was 31.7%. Prior meropenem exposure and antimicrobial treatment modification after blood culture collection were associated with higher mortality. In the revised multivariable model, central venous catheter use (adjusted OR=13.58, 95% CI: 5.02-36.60), thrombocytopenia (adjusted OR=4.82, 95% CI: 2.10-11.02), total parenteral nutrition (adjusted OR=4.83, 95% CI: 2.09-11.13), mechanical ventilation (adjusted OR=3.74, 95% CI: 1.41-9.97), and meropenem resistance (adjusted OR=3.00, 95% CI: 1.28-7.03) were independently associated with mortality.
CONCLUSIONS: Gram-negative BSIs in pediatric patients were associated with substantial antimicrobial resistance and considerable all-cause in-hospital mortality. The increase in ceftazidime-avibactam resistance should be interpreted cautiously because molecular characterization was not performed. Continuous local surveillance, antimicrobial stewardship, and infection prevention strategies are important, particularly in high-risk neonatal and pediatric intensive care populations.

abstract_en:
BACKGROUND: There is increasing evidence that gut microbiota is associated with the risk of kidney stones diseases (KSD), but whether a causal relationship exists remains unclear. We used the Mendelian randomization (MR) method to assess the potential causal relationship between gut microbiota and KSD risk.
METHODS: Genetic tool variables for the gut microbiota were identified from a genome-wide association study (GWAS) of 18340 participants. Summary statistics for KSD were derived from GWAS, including 484,598 cases and 480,873 normal controls. We used the inverse variance weighting (IVW) method as the primary analysis method.  To test the robustness of our results, we further performed the weighted-median method, MR-Egger regression, and MR pleiotropy residual sum and outlier test. Finally, reverse MR analysis was performed to evaluate the possibility of reverse causation.
RESULTS: We identified suggestive associations between four bacterial traits and the risk of KSD (odds ratio (OR): 0.82, 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.69-0.98, p= 0.032 for class. Lentisphaeria； OR：0.79, 95% CI：0.66-0.96, p=0.018 for genus. Oscillibacter； OR：0.82, 95% CI：0.68-0.98, p=0.034 for order. Victivallales； OR：1.26, 95% CI：1.03-1.53, p=0.022 for genus. Olsenella). The results of sensitivity analyses for these bacterial traits were consistent. We did not find statistically significant associations between KSD and these four bacterial traits in the reverse MR analysis.
CONCLUSION: Our systematic analysis provides evidence supporting a potential causal relationship between four gut microbiota taxa （including class. Lentisphaeria, genus. Oscillibacter, order. Victivallales and genus. Olsenella）and KSD risk. More studies are needed to demonstrate how gut microbiota influences KSD development.

abstract_en: Indwelling medical devices, such as intravenous and urinary catheters, have significantly enhanced patient care and greatly improved treatment outcomes. Despite rapid advances in medical devices, infection and thrombosis continue to pose major challenges to device functionality and integrity. Given that current treatments often involve systemic administration of antibiotics and anticoagulants, there is an urgent need for medical devices that are inherently antibacterial and antithrombotic. We explore the chemical conjugation of the nitric oxide (NO) donor S-nitroso-N-acetylpenicillamine (SNAP) with the fluoroquinolone-based, broad-spectrum antibiotic Ciprofloxacin (CIP). The combination strategy integrates the directed antibacterial activity of CIP with the antithrombotic and antibiofilm properties of NO. Furthermore, the conjugate molecule (SNAP-CIP) was incorporated into silicone rubber (SR) for catheter fabrication (SR-SNAP-CIP). SR-SNAP-CIP demonstrated NO-release for 14 days while remaining biocompatible. The NO release allowed SR-SNAP-CIP to reduce platelet adhesion in vitro by ∼45%. The dual-action material exhibited antibacterial properties when tested in vitro for bacterial adhesion (24 h and 14-day CDC bioreactor), planktonic viability, and biofilm biomass accumulation against S. aureus, and E. coli. To assess bacterial migration across the skin barrier, an ex vivo skin translocation model was performed, which showed no bacterial migration on the SR-SNAP-CIP catheter. After the 14-day in vivo rabbit catheter model, SR-SNAP-CIP showed a significant reduction (∼84%) in thrombus area on the catheter and surrounding vein. Furthermore, SR-SNAP-CIP catheters showed a 92% reduction in adhered S. aureus. Overall, SR-SNAP-CIP demonstrated a combination of technologies, harnessing the antibacterial potential of CIP and the antibiofilm and antithrombotic properties of NO. STATEMENT OF SIGNIFICANCE: Despite advancements in biomaterial design, catheter-associated thrombosis and infection persist as primary drivers of device failure and patient morbidity, highlighting the critical need for dual-functioning anti-thrombogenic and antimicrobial interventions. Materials capable of addressing both challenges simultaneously are vital to the development of next-generation, hemocompatible catheter biomaterials. In this work, we present the incorporation of a nitric oxide (NO)-releasing ciprofloxacin conjugate molecule into a polymer platform to achieve extended NO release and robust antiplatelet activity. The resulting platform demonstrated antibacterial performance in vitro, while remaining cyto- and hemo-compatible. Furthermore, these antibacterial and antithrombotic effects were sustained in a 14-day in vivo rabbit catheter model, indicating strong potential for clinical translation.

abstract_en: A large percentage of healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) are medical device-associated infections (DAIs), which significantly raise patient morbidity, mortality, and medical costs. The use of invasive medical devices such as ventilators, central venous catheters, and urinary catheters is linked to a significant number of HAIs. Reports from the World Health Organization and extensive epidemiological studies highlight the pervasive effects of HAIs, particularly in resource-constrained environments. Ventilator-associated pneumonia, central line-associated bloodstream infections, and catheter-associated urinary tract infections are the most common forms of medical DAIs. These infections frequently result in longer hospital stays and more expensive medical care. Longer device use and inadequate aseptic procedures increase the risk of infection. Furthermore, because implant-related infections are recurrent and persistent, they present additional treatment challenges. One of the main causes of medical DAIs is biofilm formation. Biofilms are structured groups of microorganisms encased in an extracellular matrix that enhances their survival and resistance. Adhesion, maturation, and dispersion are the stages of biofilm formation that lead to persistent infections. These biofilms offer defense against the immune system and antibiotics. Staphylococcus aureus, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Acinetobacter baumannii, and Klebsiella pneumoniae are common pathogens linked to DAIs; many of these pathogens exhibit multidrug resistance (MDR). Mechanisms such as carbapenem resistance and extended-spectrum β-lactamase production complicate treatment even more. On its priority list, the World Health Organization emphasizes the urgent need to address MDR pathogens.

abstract_en: Nosocomial infections remain a leading cause of postoperative morbidity and prolonged hospitalization, and they contribute to antimicrobial exposure and resistance selection. A retrospective case-control study was conducted among consecutive surgical patients treated in the operating room between January and December 2025; the sample comprised all eligible infected cases during the predefined study period and contemporaneous controls selected at a 1:1 ratio. Cases were patients who developed a postoperative nosocomial infection adjudicated using the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and National Healthcare Safety Network definitions; controls were contemporaneous surgical patients without a nosocomial infection. Data were extracted from electronic clinical, anesthesia, operating room, laboratory, and microbiology systems. Group comparisons used Welch's t test, Mann-Whitney U test, chi-square test, or Fisher's exact test. Risk factors were assessed using univariate and multivariable logistic regression, with odds ratios and 95% confidence intervals. Culture positivity was identified in 44 of 56 cases (78.6%), with the highest specimen-level yield from operative-site and respiratory samples. Among 56 non-duplicate isolates, Gram-negative bacteria predominated (58.9%), followed by Gram-positive bacteria (32.1%) and fungi (8.9%); pathogen profiles differed by syndrome, with pneumonia largely caused by Gram-negative bacteria. In multivariable analysis, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, longer preoperative length of stay, preoperative urinary catheterization, lower serum albumin, prolonged operative time, and intraoperative hypothermia were independently associated with infection risk. title_en: Multi-habitat microbiome profiling identifies habitat-dependent alterations and complementary discriminatory information in urolithiasis.
title_ja: 複数生息地マイクロバイオームプロファイリングにより、尿路結石症における生息地依存の変化と補完的な識別情報が特定されます。
authors: Jia Zhentao, Peng Yujiao, Jiang Shuangjian, Tang Yiming, Yin Hening, Huang Lijuan, Li Pengju, Mo Chengqiang, Wu Rongpei
journal: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
purpose: 尿路結石症は、個々の解剖学的ニッチにおける微生物の変化と関連しています。しかし、泌尿器、腸、口腔の生息環境全体にわたる微生物の特徴が、共通の、部位固有の、または相補的な疾患関連情報を表すかどうかは、依然として不明である。この研究は、尿路結石症に関連する複数生息地マイクロバイオームの変化を特徴づけ、統合された複数部位プロファイリングが内部で交差検証された疾患関連微生物情報を捕捉するかどうかを評価することを目的としました。
methods: 80 人の結石者 (SF) と 40 人の健康な対照 (HC) から唾液、クリーンキャッチ中流尿、および糞便サンプルを収集し、16S rRNA 遺伝子配列決定を使用してプロファイリングしました。品質管理後の最終分析データセットは、101 件の尿サンプル、117 件の糞便サンプル、および 120 件の唾液サンプルで構成され、98 人の参加者が完全な 3 つの生息地プロファイルに貢献しました。生息地固有のアルファおよびベータの多様性、分類学的変化、および探索的な推定ネットワークと予測機能プロファイルが評価されました。ランダムフォレストモデルは、単一および複数生息地の微生物の特徴からの内部識別情報を調べるために、繰り返しネストされた層化相互検証を使用して評価されました。
results: 尿路結石症は、統計的に検出可能な、3 つの生息地すべてにわたる微生物群集構造のわずかな違いと関連しており、PERMANOVA の効果サイズは小さく、分散には大きな違いがありました。 SF からの糞便サンプルは、偽発見率補正後 (すべて q = 0.022)、HC よりも低い Sobs、Chao1、および ACE 指数を含む濃厚性の大幅な低下を示しましたが、尿および唾液のアルファ多様性は広範な損失を示さなかった。分類学的変化は生息地に依存していた。唾液では最も広範な共変量に強い属レベルの候補セットが得られ、糞便では安定したHCが豊富な属の数が減少し、その濃度が低下し、尿では候補の関連性が同定されたが、尿の低バイオマス性と陰性対照の欠如のため、前向きの汚染管理された検証が必要であった。対応する参加者において、複合生息地マイクロバイオームモデルは、受信者動作特性曲線下面積 0.865 (95% CI、0.839-0.886) を達成し、年齢、性別、BMI に基づく限定された臨床のみのモデル (AUC、0.738、デルタ AUC、0.128、95% CI、0.026-0.229) を上回りました。最良の単一生息地マイクロバイオーム モデルに対する改善は、統計的に決定的ではありませんでした。外部状況分析により、KiSMi における部分的な泌尿器コミュニティレベルのサポートと、広範な共変量調整後の逆ではあるが FDR 非有意な NHANES 口腔リッチネス関連性が提供され、調和された前向き検証がサポートされました。
conclusion: これらの発見は、尿路結石症における生息地依存のマイクロバイオームの変化を特定し、統合された複数生息地プロファイリングが限られた臨床ベースラインを超えて疾患に関連する微生物情報を捕捉することを示しています。糞便濃度の低下、広範囲の唾液共変量耐性候補、生物学的に近位の尿候補、および外部コンテキストシグナルの組み合わせは、将来の機構研究およびトランスレーショナル研究のための貴重な枠組みとして、複数部位の同時プロファイリングをサポートします。厳密な低バイオマス管理、包括的な曝露メタデータ、直接的な機能測定、および事前に指定された独立した検証による前向き研究が保証されています。

abstract_en:
BACKGROUND: Urolithiasis has been associated with microbial alterations in individual anatomical niches; however, whether microbial signatures across urinary, intestinal, and oral habitats represent shared, site-specific, or complementary disease-associated information remains unclear. This study aimed to characterize multi-habitat microbiome alterations associated with urolithiasis and to evaluate whether integrated multi-site profiling captures internally cross-validated disease-associated microbial information.
METHODS: Salivary, clean-catch midstream urinary, and fecal samples were collected from 80 stone formers (SF) and 40 healthy controls (HC) and profiled using 16S rRNA gene sequencing. After quality control, the final analytical dataset comprised 101 urinary, 117 fecal, and 120 salivary samples, with 98 participants contributing complete three-habitat profiles. Habitat-specific alpha- and beta-diversity, taxonomic alterations, and exploratory inferred-network and predicted-functional profiles were evaluated. Random forest models were assessed using repeated nested stratified cross-validation to examine internal discriminatory information from single- and multi-habitat microbial features.
RESULTS: Urolithiasis was associated with statistically detectable but modest differences in microbial community structure across all three habitats, with small PERMANOVA effect sizes and significant dispersion differences. Fecal samples from SF showed significantly reduced richness, including lower Sobs, Chao1, and ACE indices than HC after false discovery rate correction (all q = 0.022), whereas urinary and salivary alpha-diversity did not show broad loss. Taxonomic alterations were habitat dependent: saliva yielded the broadest covariate-robust genus-level candidate set, feces showed fewer stable HC-enriched genera alongside reduced richness, and urinary candidate associations were identified but require prospective contamination-controlled validation because of the low-biomass nature of urine and the absence of negative controls. In matched participants, the combined multi-habitat microbiome model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.865 (95% CI, 0.839-0.886), exceeding the limited clinical-only model based on age, sex, and body mass index (AUC, 0.738; delta-AUC, 0.128; 95% CI, 0.026-0.229). Improvement over the best single-habitat microbiome model was not statistically conclusive. External contextual analyses provided partial urinary community-level support in KiSMi and an inverse but FDR-non-significant NHANES oral-richness association after extensive covariate adjustment, supporting harmonized prospective validation.
CONCLUSIONS: These findings identify habitat-dependent microbiome alterations in urolithiasis and show that integrated multi-habitat profiling captures disease-associated microbial information beyond a limited clinical baseline. The combination of reduced fecal richness, broad salivary covariate-robust candidates, biologically proximal urinary candidates, and external contextual signals supports simultaneous multi-site profiling as a valuable framework for future mechanistic and translational studies. Prospective studies with rigorous low-biomass controls, comprehensive exposure metadata, direct functional measurements, and prespecified independent validation are warranted.

title_ja: 尿路結石中のマイクロプラスチック: ヒトの尿路結石からの証拠。
authors: Carrier Kelsea, Garcia Marcus, Campen Matthew J, Patil Sakshi, El Hayek Eliane, Kotulski Jillian, Davis Michael
purpose: マイクロプラスチックとナノプラスチックは遍在する環境汚染物質であり、尿や腎臓組織などの人間の組織に存在することが記録されています。マイクロプラスチックが尿路結石症に取り込まれるかどうかはこれまで調査されていなかった。私たちは、ヒトの尿石中のマイクロプラスチックの存在とポリマー組成を決定することを目的としました。

abstract_en:
PURPOSE: Microplastics and nanoplastics are ubiquitous environmental contaminants with documented presence in human tissues, including urine and renal tissue. Whether microplastics become incorporated into urolithiasis has not been previously explored. We aimed to determine the presence and polymer composition of microplastics in human urinary stones.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Renal and bladder calculi from thirteen patients were collected intraoperatively at the University of New Mexico Hospital. Stone debris, otherwise discarded, underwent potassium hydroxide digestion followed by ultracentrifugation for microplastics isolation under contamination-controlled conditions. Polymer identification was performed using pyrolysis gas chromatography-mass spectrometry targeting twelve polymer standards. Quality controls included blanks and procedural standards to exclude contamination.
RESULTS: Microplastics were identified in 100% (13/13) of specimens, with each specimen containing at least one polymer quantified above the limit of quantification (LOQ). Additional polymer detections between the limit of detection (LOD) and LOQ further supported the presence of microplastics across all samples. Polyethylene, polyethylene terephthalate, polyvinyl chloride, nylon 6, and styrene-butadiene rubber were consistently detected across all samples. All stones contained multiple polymer types, suggesting heterogeneous incorporation. Detection rates exceeded those previously reported in urine and renal tissue studies, indicating a potential affinity of microplastics and nanoplastics for stone matrices.
CONCLUSIONS: This study provides the first evidence of microplastics within human urolithiasis. The consistent detection of common environmental polymers supports the hypothesis that microplastics and nanoplastics may act as nucleation substrates or become entrapped during stone crystallization. Given the rising global prevalence of urolithiasis, these findings implicate environmental plastic exposure as a novel contributor to stone pathogenesis and underscore the importance of investigating planetary health determinants of urologic disease.

title_en: Antimicrobial Glucose Chlorhexidine Dressings vs. Sterile Dressings in Preventing Catheter-Related Infections During Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
title_ja: 持続腎代替療法中のカテーテル関連感染症の予防における抗菌性グルコースクロルヘキシジンドレッシングと滅菌ドレッシングの比較：ランダム化対照試験。
authors: Zhang Xuemei, Wang Fang, Zheng Yi, Sun Xiankun, Lin Li, Tang Xue, Chen Zhiwen, Zhang Ling
study_design: ランダム化比較試験／臨床試験
purpose: カテーテル関連血流感染症 (CRBSI) は、持続腎代替療法 (CRRT) を受けている重症患者、特にトンネル型カテーテルを使用していない患者における合併症の主な原因です。これらの感染症は、入院期間の延長、費用の増加、患者の転帰の悪化につながる可能性があります。 CRBSI を予防するために滅菌包帯が一般的に使用されますが、クロルヘキシジンを含む抗菌包帯などの抗菌包帯はより良い保護を提供する可能性があります。この研究は、CRRT を受けている患者における CRBSI の予防における抗菌性グルコース クロルヘキシジン包帯と滅菌包帯の有効性を比較することを目的としました。
methods: 前向きのランダム化対照単盲検研究が実施されました。すべての参加者はグループ割り当てを知らされなかった。我々は、2022年9月から2023年11月までに四川大学西中国病院の集中治療室（ICU）に入院し、持続腎代替療法（CRRT）を受ける前に血管カテーテル留置が予定されていた患者を登録した。参加者は、乱数表によって介入グループ (グルコース クロルヘキシジン抗菌包帯を受け取る) または対照グループ (無菌包帯を受け取る) のいずれかにランダムに割り当てられました。ガイドラインに従って、グルコースクロルヘキシジン抗菌群では 7 日ごとに、滅菌包帯群では 48 時間ごとに包帯を交換しました。ドレッシングが丸まったり、緩んだり、目に見えて汚れたりした場合は、すぐに交換しました。主要アウトカムは、カテーテル挿入部位の局所感染率、カテーテル関連血流感染症（CRBSI）の疑い、CRBSIの発生率、入院期間、ICU滞在期間、および病院死亡率であった。
results: 合計520人の患者がスクリーニングされ、最終的に410人の患者が研究に参加し、各グループ(グルコースクロルヘキシジン抗菌包帯群および無菌包帯群)に205人の患者が含まれた。カテーテル挿入部位における局所感染の発生率は、滅菌包帯群で40.0%であり、グルコースクロルヘキシジン抗菌包帯群で報告された15.6%よりも有意に高かった(p < 0.001)。介入グループの合計 CRBSI 率 (6.3%) は、対照グループ (13.7%) よりも有意に低かった (p = 0.014)。カテーテル関連血流感染症（CRBSI）の疑い、CRBSIの発生率、入院期間、ICU滞在期間、または入院死亡率に関して、2つのグループ間に有意差は見つかりませんでした（p > 0.05）。 Cox 比例ハザード モデルは、対照群の患者は介入群の患者よりも時間の経過とともに局所感染症および CRBSI のリスクが大幅に高いことを示唆しました。
conclusion: グルコースクロルヘキシジン抗菌包帯は、カテーテル挿入部位の感染症と全体的な CRBSI 発生率を大幅に減少させ、CRRT を受けている患者の感染予防における臨床的価値を示しています。

abstract_en:
BACKGROUND: Catheter-related bloodstream infections (CRBSIs) are a major cause of complications in critically ill patients receiving continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT), especially those with nontunneled catheters. These infections can lead to longer hospital stays, higher costs, and worse patient outcomes. Although sterile dressings are commonly used to prevent CRBSIs, antimicrobial dressings, such as those containing chlorhexidine, may offer better protection. This study aimed to compare the effectiveness of antimicrobial glucose chlorhexidine dressings and sterile dressings in preventing CRBSIs in patients receiving CRRT.
METHODS: A prospective, randomized controlled, single-blind study was conducted. All participants were kept blinded to group assignment. We enrolled patients admitted to the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) of West China Hospital, Sichuan University between September 2022 and November 2023 who were scheduled for vascular catheter placement before receiving continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT). The participants were randomly allocated to either the intervention group (receiving glucose chlorhexidine antimicrobial dressing) or the control group (receiving sterile dressing) via a random number table. The dressing was changed every 7 days for the glucose chlorhexidine antimicrobial group and every 48 h for the sterile dressing group, in accordance with the guideline. Dressings were replaced immediately if they became rolled, loose, or visibly soiled. The primary outcomes were the local infection rate at the catheter insertion site, suspected catheter-related bloodstream infections (CRBSIs), incidence of CRBSIs, length of hospital stay, ICU stay duration, and hospital mortality rates.
RESULTS: A total of 520 patients were screened, and 410 patients were ultimately included in the study, with 205 patients in each group (glucose chlorhexidine antimicrobial dressing group and sterile dressing group). The incidence of local infection at the catheter insertion site was 40.0% in the sterile dressing group, which was significantly greater than the 15.6% reported in the glucose chlorhexidine antimicrobial dressing group (p < 0.001). The total CRBSI rate in the intervention group was significantly lower (6.3%) than that in the control group (13.7%) (p = 0.014). No significant differences were found between the two groups in terms of suspected catheter-related bloodstream infections (CRBSIs), CRBSI incidence, length of hospital stay, ICU stay duration, or hospital mortality rates (p > 0.05). The Cox proportional hazards model suggested that patients in the control group were at a substantially greater risk of local infections and CRBSIs over time than those in the intervention group.
CONCLUSION: Glucose chlorhexidine antimicrobial dressings significantly reduce catheter insertion site infections and overall CRBSI incidence, demonstrating their clinical value in preventing infection in patients receiving CRRT.

study_design: 系統的レビュー／メタ解析
purpose: この系統的レビューは、尿道カテーテル留置術（IUC）を有する非手術患者におけるカテーテル関連尿路感染症（UTI）およびカテーテル関連無症候性細菌尿の予防/解決に対する、抗生物質の投与なしまたは代替レジメンと比較した経験的な抗生物質の効果を評価することを目的としました。
methods: 5 つのデータベースにわたって文献検索が実行されました。証拠の合成は、メタ分析を使用しない合成ガイドライン (SWiM) に準拠しました。
results: 4,907 人の参加者が参加した 4 つの研究が分析されました。カテーテル関連尿路感染症の細菌学的分解能はさまざまで、治療群（メロペネム）と未治療群の間に有意差は示されず（p > 0.05）、ホスホマイシンでは最大53.6％の除去を達成しました。重要なことに、尿培養陽性の反復率は抗生物質群間で異なり(p = 0.000)、ホスホマイシン群での再発率が最も高かった。臨床転帰を調査した 2 つの研究では、抗生物質群間に有意差は報告されませんでした。
conclusion:
効果の全体的な方向性は、抗生物質群間に有意差がないこと、または非カルバペネム療法を支持する結果のいずれかを示しました。 IUC患者のカテーテル関連感染症の解消に対する経験的抗生物質療法の効果について最終的な結論を出すには、証拠がまだ不十分である。

abstract_en:
AIM: This systematic review aimed to assess the effect of empirical antibiotics in comparison with no antibiotics or alternative regimens on the prevention/resolution of catheter-associated urinary tract infection (UTIs) and catheter-associated asymptomatic bacteriuria among nonsurgical patients with indwelling urinary catheters (IUCs).
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A literature search was performed across five databases. Evidence synthesis adhered to the Synthesis Without Meta-analysis guidelines (SWiM).
RESULTS: Four studies involving 4,907 participants were analyzed. The bacteriological resolution of catheter-associated UTIs varied, showing no significant difference between the treated group (meropenem) and the untreated group (p > 0.05), and achieving up to 53.6% clearance with fosfomycin. Significantly, the rate of repeat positive urine cultures differed between the antibiotic groups (p = 0.000), with the highest recurrence in the fosfomycin group. Two studies examining clinical outcomes reported no significant differences between the antibiotic groups.
CONCLUSION: The overall direction of effect indicated either no significant difference between antibiotic groups or outcomes favoring non-carbapenem therapy. The evidence remains insufficient for definitive conclusions on the effect of empirical antibiotic therapy on the resolution of catheter-associated infection among persons with IUC.
PROSPERO PROTOCOL REGISTRATION: https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/prospero/ identifier is CRD420251062752.

title_ja: ThuLEP における尿道カテーテル挿入の最適期間: ランダム化された前向きパイロット研究。
authors: Gómez-Luque Miguel Ángel, Campanario-Pérez Rubén, Curbelo-Ascanio Nadia María, Argüelles-Salido Enrique, García-Sánchez Cristina, Medina-López Rafael Antonio
study_design: ランダム化比較試験／臨床試験
purpose: はじめに: 前立腺良性閉塞 (BPO) による下部尿路症状 (LUTS) は、高齢の男性によく見られます。 TURP やレーザー核出などの外科的介入は、薬剤抵抗性の BPO に対する確立された治療法です。
methods: これまでの研究では、選択された患者において HoLEP 後に同日にカテーテル抜去が可能であることが裏付けられています。この研究は、ThuLEP 後の 24 時間のカテーテル挿入と 72 時間のカテーテル挿入の結果を比較することを目的としています。材料と方法：このランダム化された前向きパイロット研究は、将来の確認試験のための予備証拠を生成することを目的として、術後の排尿動態（Qmax）の観点から、24時間のカテーテル挿入が72時間のカテーテル挿入と同等の結果をもたらすかどうかを調査するように設計されました。

abstract_en:
INTRODUCTION: Lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) from benign prostatic obstruction (BPO) are common in aging men. Surgical interventions such as TURP and laser enucleation are established treatments for drug-refractory BPO. Holmium laser enucleation (HoLEP) has demonstrated favorable long-term safety and efficacy with shorter hospitalization and catheterization times compared to standard TURP. Thulium laser enucleation (ThuLEP) emerges as an effective and safe option, potentially offering advantages including reduced blood loss and shorter catheterization periods compared to TURP. Postoperative catheterization duration following laser enucleation varies among institutions, with an increasing trend toward early catheter removal. Previous studies support the feasibility of same-day catheter removal after HoLEP in selected patients. This study aims to compare outcomes of 24-hour versus 72-hour catheterization following ThuLEP.
MATERIAL AND METHODS: This randomized prospective pilot study was designed to explore whether 24-hour catheterization yields comparable outcomes to 72-hour catheterization in terms of postoperative voiding dynamics (Qmax), with the aim of generating preliminary evidence for future confirmatory trials. Patients were randomly assigned preoperatively to catheter removal at 24 hours (Group 1) or 72 hours (Group 2). Validated questionnaires (SF-36, ICIQ-SF, IPSS) were administered preoperatively, before discharge, and at follow-up, with uroflowmetry performed. A total of 42 patients (21 per group) were included.
RESULTS: No clinically significant differences were observed between groups. Postoperative complications occurred in 7 cases: 1 in the 24-hour group and 6 in the 72-hour group, including urinary leakage, hematuria, and acute urinary retention.
CONCLUSION: Early catheter removal at 24 hours following ThuLEP appears to yield comparable urinary function and patient-reported outcomes to the standard 72-hour protocol in this cohort. These preliminary findings support the feasibility of early catheter removal and provide a basis for future confirmatory trials.
